lessons.prerequisite: Afþjappið Volcano_real_guide_family.zip og opnið results. Óbreytt úttak Regression-dæmis, ekki ný greining eða heildarsafn. Ein fjölskylda: 434 leiðsögur, log_pred, minimum_wells_threshold=2, plús-einn umraðana-P og BH-leiðrétting. Lægsta hráa P=.005, leiðrétta P=.39454545454545453; ekkert marktækt við upprunalegt alpha=.05. Staðlað jaðarhrif eru ekki samtímis metnir stuðlar eða log2-breytingar. Upphafsvilla helst: stýringar 1e-6/0/False en teikning .05/3/True. Vistið og lesið sama stíl fyrir breytingu; síðar endurheimtast allir 67 reitir. Alpha .5 setur 19 gildi undir þröskuld án nýrra marktæknimerkja. Endurstillið .05 og adjusted_p_value. Áhrifaþröskuldur .1 sinnum 3 gefur línur +/-0.3. Auðkenni, punktar, litir og frumgögn könnuð. Nafnstærð 7×5 tommur, 150 DPI; þétt skorin PDF 492.536×348.485 punktar, PNG 1026×726 mynddílar. Innfelld letur, engar rastamyndir í PDF, læsileiki endurskoðaður. Sum GUI-heiti eru skorin; viðvörun um hvítar útlínur á ljósum pappír. Samtenging athugasemda, rofnir ásar og MAD-reglur eru utan dæmisins. Upptaka spaCR 1.5.0.4; þrjár viðeigandi frumskrár óbreyttar. Ekkert nýtt próf, GPU, gervigreind, appbreyting, líffræðileg staðfesting eða birting. API: spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle og render_volcano.

scenes.narration: Opnið Regression og innbyggða Volcano Explorer. Kennslan tilheyrir undireiningum Regression. Verkfærið les tilbúnar niðurstöður en endurkeyrir ekki greininguna. Við notum raunverulega niðurhalsdæmið; meðfylgjandi safn inniheldur nákvæmar niðurstöðutöflur og skráða myndstíla.

Veljið Open results og afþjöppuðu results-möppuna. Hver punktur er leiðsaga úr einni fjölskyldu 434 prófa með sömu útkomu og lágmarksbrunnareglu. Blandið ekki leiðréttingarfjölskyldum. Engin leiðsaga er marktæk við upprunalega leiðrétta P-þröskuldinn 0,05.

Áður en stillingu er breytt skal vista raunverulega teiknaða stílinn með Save style og lesa sömu skrá með Load style. Upphafsstýringar passa ekki við myndina í þessari útgáfu; tafarlaus breyting getur dregið inn röng sjálfgefin gildi. Þessi venjulega vistunar- og lestrarleið samstillir þau en lagar ekki appið.

Staðfestið síðan alfa 0,05, margfaldara þrjá og neikvæða lógaritmaumbreytingu. Sum heiti eru enn skorin, svo skoðið gildi og JSON. Lárétti ásinn sýnir stöðluð jaðarhrif, ekki log-tveggja hlutfallsbreytingu eða stuðul úr samtímis metnu fjölbreytulíkani.

Smellið á fyrirliggjandi punkt til að lesa upprunaröðina. Valin leiðsaga hefur hrátt P=0,005 en leiðrétt P um 0,39. Mikil jaðarhrif og fjórir stuðningsbrunnar gera hana ekki marktæka. Notið auðkenni og frumreiti frekar en að giska út frá staðsetningu.

Að breyta lóðrétta dálkinum í hrátt umraðana-P breytir stærðinni sem er teiknuð, ekki greiningunni. Lítil hrá gildi koma ekki í stað fjölskylduleiðréttra gilda. Endurheimtið leiðrétt P á eftir. Upprunaleg marktæknimerki haldast; verkfærið les og teiknar, það gerir ekki nýtt próf.

Rofinn fyrir neikvæðan tíundarlógaritma breytir P-birtingu. Virkur sýnir lítil P ofar; óvirkur sýnir upprunagildin. Hér endurheimtum við umbreytt leiðrétt P. Lesið alltaf ásinn og ruglið ekki þessari umbreytingu við aðra fjölprófunarleiðréttingu.

Í sýnikennslunni er alfa fært í 0,5 og viðmiðunarlínan færist. Nítján leiðrétt gildi liggja undir nýja P-þröskuldinum en ekkert fær nýtt marktæknimerki. Þetta eru ekki nítján uppgötvanir. Endurheimtið upprunalegt 0,05 áður en flutt er út eða túlkað.

Skýr áhrifaþröskuldur 0,1 með margfaldara þremur setur lóðréttar línur við mínus og plús 0,3. Athugið margfaldarann, ekki aðeins þröskuldsreitinn. Áhrifaþröskuldur kemur ekki í stað tölfræðilegrar leiðréttingar. Endurheimtið Auto; engin niðurstöðugildi eru endurskrifuð.

Litur eftir wells with guide sýnir raunverulegan stuðning úr frumtöflunni. Hann er ekki traustseinkunn eða sönnun nákvæmni. Farið aftur í upprunalega marktækniliti fyrir útflutning. Valfrjáls samtenging athugasemda og önnur uppsetning krefjast eigin sannprófunar og eru utan dæmisins.

Stillið myndstærð, letur og upplausn og skoðið útkomuna. Hér er nafnstærð sjö sinnum fimm tommur við 150 punkta á tommu. Þétt skurður breytir lokastærðinni. Læsileg útflutt mynd þýðir ekki að öll innbyggð stillingaheiti rúmist í glugganum.

Vistið lokastílinn sem JSON. Eftir tímabundna breytingu á punktastærð endurheimtir Load style alla skráða reiti. Geymið skrána með frumtöflunni svo endurskapa megi útlitið. Stíll lýsir framsetningu, ekki að önnur aðhvarfsgreining eða nýtt próf hafi verið keyrt.

Export PDF og PNG teikna myndina aftur, en taka ekki skjáskot. PDF hefur vigurmerki og innfelld letur; skoðið heiti, birtuskil og viðvörun um hvítar útlínur á ljósum pappír. Frumgögn haldast óbreytt. Python býður VolcanoStyle og render_volcano án GPU eða gervigreindarþjónustu.

lessons.title: Prófun á stikum
lessons.description: Keyrðu tvær prófanir í Regression og greindu á milli lokinnar útreikningskeyrslu og gildrar ályktunar.
objectives: Velja fjögur pör skráa með skor og talningar í sömu röð.
Takmarka leitina við tvær prófanir og eitt vinnsluferli og skoða vistaðar niðurstöður.
Halda stuðlafjölskyldum aðskildum og taka fram að ályktunarprófanir standist ekki.
lessons.prerequisite: Notaðu fjögur niðurhöluð plötupör úr Regression-kennslunni og nýja úttaksmöppu. Báðar ridge-keyrslurnar falla á gæðaprófun ályktana; þetta er ekki staðfest líffræðileg niðurstaða. Aðeins alpha breytist, 0.01 og 0.1. Stikabundin ályktun, meðaltal á hvern brunn og engin umbreyting eru valin sérstaklega. Aðrar stillingar yfirskipaða formsins erfast ekki sjálfkrafa. n_rows_fitted telur hér 1174 stuðlaraðir, ekki 620 brunna eða 2955 undirbúnar gagnaraðir. Skoðaðu sweep_results.csv og raunverulegar stillingar; taflan sleppir alpha og gæðaniðurstöðum. API: spacr.parameter_sweep.SweepSpace og run_sweep_parallel. Engin GPU-hraðamæling, ytri AI-fyrirspurn, samþykki móðurmálshafa eða birting.

scenes.narration: Opnaðu Regression og síðan Parameter sweep neðst til hægri. Þetta verkflæði er inni í Regression, ekki á sérstökum Home-reit. Regression-kennslan sýnir hvernig fjögur pör skráa með skor og talningar eru sótt; þau eru notuð aftur hér.

Athugaðu eigin inntakslista stikaprófunarinnar. Þeir eru upphaflega tómir þótt yfirskipaða formið innihaldi pöruð gögn. Bættu við fjórum skorskrám og fjórum talningarskrám í sömu plöturöð. Veldu nýja úttaksmöppu svo sýnidæmið skrifi ekki yfir eldri greiningu.

Merktu aðeins alpha, með núll komma núll einum og núll komma einum. Ómerktar raðir gefa samt fastar stillingar. Hér veljum við sérstaklega ridge, stikabundna ályktun, meðaltal á hvern brunn og enga umbreytingu. Þessi afmarkaða uppskrift sýnir notkun, ekki ráðleggingu fyrir þína tilraun.

Veldu grid, að hámarki tvær prófanir og eitt vinnsluferli, og smelltu á Estimate. Tvær gildar samsetningar merkir að stillingarnar séu leyfðar, ekki að tölfræðilegar ályktanir séu gildar. Tímaáætlunin gerir ráð fyrir mínútu á prófun; hún er ekki hraðamæling. Lestu auðlindamörkin áður en þú byrjar.

Smelltu á Start sweep, ekki Run í yfirskipaða Regression-forminu. Hver prófun skrifar í eigin möppu. Þessar tvær raunverulegu prófanir keyra í röð; fleiri vinnsluferli auka auðlindaþörf. Dæmið sýnir aðhvarf á CPU, ekki GPU-hröðun, og þarf enga fyrirspurn til spaCR AI.

Báðar raðir sýna ok því útreikningum er lokið. En báðar vistaðar gæðaprófanir ályktana sýna fail. Taflan sleppir þessum niðurstöðum og breytilega alpha: skoðaðu alla niðurstöðuskrána og stillingar hverrar prófunar. Veldu ekki líkan aðeins vegna þess að það gefur fleiri lítil leiðrétt P-gildi.

Veldu fyrstu röð og smelltu á Show figures for selected row. Vistaðar niðurstöður eru lesnar án nýrrar líkanaðlögunar. Leiðsögusýnin hefur 792 stuðlaraðir, þar á meðal skurðpunkt; myndin sleppir þessum hjálparlið og sýnir 791 leiðsögur. Hæðin er neikvæður tuglogri hráa P-gildisins.

Breyttu Level í Gene. Taflan hefur nú 382 raðir með sínum skurðpunkti og myndin sýnir 381 gen. Leiðsögur og gen eru aðskildar stuðlafjölskyldur. Breytt sýn gerir fallna ályktunarprófun ekki gilda og skapar ekki óháðar sannanir.

Farðu aftur í leiðsögur: upphaflegar raðir og punktar koma aftur og vistuðu skrárnar eru óbreyttar. Reiturinn rows fitted í samantektinni er villandi hér: hann telur stuðlaraðir, ekki brunna. Greindu á milli fjölda inntakssýna, úttaksstuðla og fjölskyldunnar sem birtist þegar þú skýrir frá greiningu.

Lestu vistaðar stillingar, samantekt og gæðaeftirlitsskrár saman. Mynd eða AI-skýring getur ekki staðfest rannsóknarsnið. Regression Diagnostics fjallar um frekari skoðun, en API-heimildin lýsir keyrslu stikaprófana. Dæmið kennir endurtakanlegt verkflæði og takmarkanir þess, ekki staðfestar líffræðilegar niðurstöður.

lessons.title: Import Images: skoðaðu áætlunina áður en þú flytur inn
lessons.description: Opnaðu Import Images innan Import, skoðaðu lítið úrval raunverulegra smásjármynda áður en skrár eru skrifaðar og vistaðu endurnýtanlega áætlun. Dæmið greinir á milli upprunalegra nafna sem ekki eru studd og undirbúinna afrita.
objectives: Finna Import Images innan Import og greina það frá innflutningi fyrirliggjandi mælinga og gríma.
Athuga auðkenni mynda og óleysta hluta skráarheita áður en verkefnið er skrifað.
Velja afrit eða tengla, vista og endurhlaða áætlun og sannreyna innflutninginn.
lessons.prerequisite: Sæktu fyrst raunverulega Mask-dæmið. Upptakan notar afrit af myndsviðunum E01/F001 og L01/F009, með fjórum C-rásum á hvoru sviði. Í undirbúnu afritunum er aðeins A-hlutanum beint á undan Z sleppt; frumritin breytast ekki. Þetta er sérstaklega yfirfarið dæmi, ekki almenn ráðlegging um að eyða óþekktum lýsigögnum.

scenes.narration: Opnaðu Import í Data-flokknum á Home og veldu Import Images. Þetta undirverkfæri undirbýr hráar myndskrár. Import Project, Format Converter og External Masks eru tengd verkferli með eigin kennsluefni.

Myndirnar átta eru raunveruleg smásjárgögn úr Mask-dæminu sem hægt er að sækja: eitt myndsvið úr hvorum tveggja brunna, með fjórum rásum á sviði. Við vinnum með sérstök afrit og látum sóttu frumritin vera óbreytt.

Scan finnur óleystan myndtökuhluta í upprunalegu heitunum. Import er áfram óvirkt og ekkert er skrifað. Ekki giska á rásavörpun: Tvær ólíkar rásir deila þessu myndtökugildi og slík vörpun myndi rugla auðkennum þeirra.

Í þessu yfirfarna dæmi sleppa undirbúnu afritin aðeins óþarfa myndtökuhlutanum. Heiti brunns, myndsviðs og rásar haldast óbreytt. Scan sýnir nú átta línur, tvo brunna, tvö myndsviðsnúmer og fjórar rásir. Það þýðir ekki að upprunalega nafngiftin hafi verið samþykkt.

Berðu tillöguna saman við skráarheitin áður en þú flytur inn. Read inside each file kannar innbyggð ásalýsigögn auk heitanna. Sample takmarkar fjölda skoðaðra skráa; gakktu úr skugga um að tillagan nái yfir myndirnar sem þú ætlar að flytja inn. Svaraðu spurningum út frá myndtökuskráningum, ekki ágiskunum.

Veldu áfangastað utan inntaksmöppunnar og stilltu heiti plötunnar. Við slökkvum á Link instead of copy til að búa til sjálfstætt verkefni. Tenglar spara diskpláss, en frumritin þurfa áfram að vera aðgengileg á núverandi stöðum.

Þessar dæmismyndir eru ekki hlutar af myndflísamósaík. Lestu Tiles vandlega við slíka myndtöku: Samsetning endurbyggir myndsvið, að halda flísum aðskildum breytir því hvað myndsvið merkir og að sleppa þeim tapar þessum myndum. Athugaðu skýrsluna og óstaðfest samskeyti áður en þú mælir.
Save plan skrifar uppruna og vörpunarsvör þín í JSON-skrá, ekki öryggisafrit af myndunum. Geymdu hana með myndtökunótunum. Sama áætlun má lesa í gegnum Python-forritaskilin fyrir myndainnflutning.

Load plan les upprunamöppuna aftur og endurnýtir vistuðu svörin. Skoðaðu nýju tillöguna áður en þú flytur inn; vistuð áætlun tryggir ekki að breytt myndtaka sé rétt túlkuð. Hér endurheimtir hún sömu átta yfirförnu myndauðkennin.

Ýttu á Import og lestu samantektina. Þessi keyrsla skrifaði átta sjálfstæð myndafrit án þess að sleppa skrám; innihaldið samsvarar upprunanum. Veldu síðan verkefnið í Mask og skoðaðu lifandi forskoðun áður en myndirnar eru hlutaðar. Innflutningur einn og sér býr hvorki til grímur né mælingar.

lessons.title: Regression Diagnostics: skildu forsendurnar að baki niðurstöðunum
lessons.description: Opnaðu greiningarskrár úr raunverulegri úrvinnslu skimunar með dæmigögnum, greindu á milli viðvarana um tilraunasniðið og niðurstaðna umröðunarprófa og þekktu takmarkanir stuttrar sýnikeyrslu.
objectives: Opna Diagnostics í Regression og staðfesta hvaða úttaksmappa er skoðuð.
Túlka auðkennanleika tilraunasniðs, tíðni leiðsöguraða og ályktunarmyndir í samhengi við valda greiningu.
Þekkja ástæðu þess að leifamyndir vantar og takmarkaða upplausn umröðunarprófa án þess að gera ráð fyrir að líkan hafi verið aðlagað.
lessons.prerequisite: Ljúktu Regression-dæminu með fjórum niðurhalanlegum pörum af skor- og talningarskrám. Upptakan skoðar afmarkaða óstikaða keyrslu með 199 umröðunum, að lágmarki tveimur brunnum og niðurstöðum fyrir bæði leiðsöguraðir og gen. Hún sýnir hugbúnaðinn og túlkun greiningarmynda, ekki fullnægjandi lokagreiningu til að staðfesta uppgötvanir.

scenes.narration: Haltu bendlinum yfir Diagnostics í Regression og opnaðu það þegar greiningu er lokið. Hnappurinn les vistað úttak; hann aðlagar ekki annað líkan. Hann opnar nýjustu greiningarmöppuna í verkefninu, svo athugaðu slóðina ef margar keyrslur eru til.

Skráastjóri kerfisins sýnir raunverulegar skrár úr greiningu niðurhalaðra skimunardæmigagna. Hér var myndasniðið stillt á PNG. Mappan inniheldur myndir um auðkennanleika tilraunasniðsins, greiningu sniðsins og tölfræðilega ályktun, ásamt yfirlitstöflu og töflu yfir samlínuleg pör leiðsöguraða.

Tilraunasniðið hefur 606 brunna, 793 stika og fylkisröð 599. Ekki er hægt að ákvarða ótvíræðan stuðul fyrir hverja leiðsöguröð samtímis. Viðvörunin skýrir hvers vegna við notuðum umröðunargreiningu; hún þýðir ekki að sameiginlegt líkan hafi verið aðlagað með árangri.

Leiðsöguraðirnar koma misoft fyrir: 355 þeirra eru aðeins í einum brunni í þessu sniði. Fá tilvik takmarka hvað tilraunin getur sýnt. Skoðaðu þekjuna áður en áhrif eru túlkuð og greindu á milli alls sniðsins og síaða hópsins sem var raunverulega prófaður.

Myndin af tilraunasniðinu hjálpar til við að finna litla þekju og háð milli skýribreyta leiðsöguraða. Erfitt er að aðgreina tölfræðilega raðir sem koma alltaf saman fyrir. Skoðaðu tiltekin pör í samlínuleikatöflunni í stað þess að líta á viðvörunartákn sem fullnægjandi skýringu.

Ályktunarmyndin tekur saman 434 próf á leiðsöguröðum: dreifingu p-gilda, samanburð við jafna dreifingu undir núlltilgátunni og uppgötvanir við leiðrétt viðmið. Þessi stutta keyrsla hefur engar uppgötvanir við sýnt viðmið. Viðvörun um kvörðun kallar á athugun, en er ekki sönnun fyrir líffræðilegum áhrifum.

Við notuðum aðeins 199 umröðanir til að hafa sýnikeyrsluna stutta. Lægsta mögulega reynslubundna p-gildið er því 0,005. Þessi upplausn getur verið ófullnægjandi eftir leiðréttingu fyrir mörgum prófum. Veldu vel skipulagðan fjölda umröðana fyrir raunverulegu greininguna.

Þessi umröðunarkeyrsla hefur enga mynd af leifum aðlagaðs líkans því hún aðlagaði ekki sameiginlega aðhvarfslíkanið. Samanburður p-gildanna sem við sáum var ekki leifagreining. Aðrar greiningaraðferðir geta skrifað leifamyndir þegar þær skila mældum og aðlöguðum gildum.

Yfirlitið skráir mat á hverri mynd og versta matið fyrir greininguna í heild. Lestu hvert mat í samhengi í stað þess að túlka heildartáknið sem hugbúnaðarvillu. Python-forritaskilin fyrir aðhvarfsgreiningarmyndir skrifa sams konar myndir út frá gögnunum sem þau fá.

Farðu aftur í Regression til að skoða inntakið eða breyta greiningarvali af ásettu ráði. Breyting krefst nýrrar keyrslu og nýrra greiningarmynda; það uppfærir aldrei eldri niðurstöður að opna möppuna. Regression-leiðbeiningarnar fara yfir allt gagnasafnið, stjórnborðið, gagnvirkar niðurstöður og aðstoðina.

lessons.title: Embeddings: núverandi skjár og raunverulegt Python-dæmi
lessons.description: Skoðaðu nýju eininguna og kóðaðu raunmyndir með API án þess að halda fram lagfærðu myndviðmóti eða líffræðilegri staðfestingu.
objectives: Greina á milli núverandi myndviðmóts og virks API.
Bera rásastefnur saman á sextán myndum.
Varðveita auðkenni og túlka myndrit með varúð.
lessons.prerequisite: spaCR 1.5.0.7 með embeddings-viðbót; upptakan notar timm 1.0.29 og forþjálfað ResNet18 á örgjörva. Sæktu Annotate-dæmið og tengdu ZIP-skrána. Notaðu cell_png-möppuna í README og nýjar úttaksmöppur. Skráarnöfn eru ekki staðfestir gagnagrunnslyklar. Skjárinn hefur ekki myndahleðslu; árangursrík vinnsla fer fram með API. Ekki er fullyrt um líffræðilega staðfestingu, yfirferð móðurmálshafa eða GPU-keyrslu.

scenes.narration: Embeddings er ný eining á Home-síðu spaCR. Hún breytir myndútskurðum í talnavigra án þess að þjálfa á merkingunum þínum. Kennslan sýnir núverandi skjá og virkt Python-dæmi með raunverulegum niðurhöluðum myndum.

Í útgáfu eitt punktur fimm punktur núll punktur sjö hefur þessi skjár enga stýringu til að hlaða myndútskurðum og Embed er óvirkt. Við líkjum ekki eftir árangursríkri myndviðmótskeyrslu. Raunverulega kóðunin sem kemur næst er framkvæmd með studdu Python-API.

Per channel kóðar hverja vistaða rás sérstaklega og tengir vigurna saman. Project to three kóðar samsettu myndina í staðinn. Þetta breytir framsetningunni, ekki aðeins hraðanum. Rásasæti í PNG auðkennir ekki sjálfkrafa staðfesta litun.

Settu valkvæðu embeddings-viðbótina upp í spaCR-umhverfinu. Sjálfgefna ResNet átján notar ImageNet-vogir úr stýrðu námi, ekki sjálfstýrt líkan þjálfað á frumum. Þetta litla dæmi notar örgjörvann; hvorki GPU né ytri gervigreindarþjónusta er nauðsynleg.

Notaðu niðurhalanlega Annotate-dæmið og útskurðamöppuna í leiðbeiningunum. Tengda skriftan velur sextán fyrirliggjandi myndir í röð eftir skráarnafni. Hver mynd er tvö hundruð tuttugu og fjórir pixlar á hvorn veg með þremur vistuðum rásum. Hvorki stærðarbreyting né ný hlutun fer fram.

Keyrðu skriftuna með nýrri úttaksmöppu. Hún kallar á embed_array með raunverulegum forþjálfuðum kóðara og fjögurra mynda lotum. Kóðun eftir rás gefur sextán raðir og eitt þúsund fimm hundruð þrjátíu og sex víddir. Vistaða fylkið er opnað aftur og hvert gildi athugað.

Veldu nú project og aðra úttaksmöppu. Sömu myndir gefa sextán raðir og fimm hundruð tólf víddir. Þessir dálkar með samsettum rásum koma ekki í stað fyrri rásaskiptu dálkanna. Berðu stefnurnar saman af ásettu ráði og geymdu stillingar hverrar keyrslu.

Skoðaðu yfirlitið yfir raunverulegu inntaksmyndirnar í myndskoðaranum. Númerin fylgja röð úttaksraðanna. Athugaðu gæði útskurða og rásavörpun útflutningsins áður en vigur er túlkaður. Skráarnöfn auðkenna dæmið; staðfestu hlutalykla fyrir samtengingu við mæligagnagrunn.

Þetta vistaða myndrit varpar rásaskiptu vigrunum á tvo aðalþætti. Númeruðu punktarnir vísa til sömu útskurða. Þetta er könnunarmynd af mjög litlu úrtaki, ekki sönnun fyrir ólíkum svipgerðum. Ein vídd í vigri er ekki líffræðileg mæling.

Vigrarnir með samsettum rásum hafa sína eigin vörpun. Ekki bera ásahnit þessara aðskildu myndrita saman eins og þau notuðu sömu aðlöguðu umbreytingu. Hvorugt myndrit mælir endurheimtarnákvæmni eða sýnir að vigrar séu betri en safn mældra eiginleika.

Geymdu vigra, auðkenni upprunamynda, gátsummu voganna, stillingar og útgáfur hugbúnaðarpakka. Skriftan athugar að upprunamyndir séu óbreyttar og hafnar fyrirliggjandi úttaksstöðum. Samræmdu útskurði, stöðlun og rásavörpun við samanburð. Fylgdu tengdu leiðbeiningunum til að endurtaka API-dæmið.

lessons.title: OPS: núverandi viðmót og samstilling fjögurra myndflísa
lessons.description: Finndu OPS undir Mask og skoðaðu sannreynt dæmi um samstillingu og samsetningu fjögurra raunverulegra myndflísa. Þetta er ekki full vinnsla á plötu, frumuskipting eða afkóðun.
objectives: Finna innfelldu OPS-síðuna og skilja takmarkanir dæmisins.
Samstilla fjórar samliggjandi myndflísar án þess að breyta upprunalegum hnitum.
Skoða skörun, þekju og vistaðar upplýsingar um uppruna.
lessons.prerequisite: Upptakan notar Python-skilin ops_layout, ops_stitch og ops_compose úr spaCR 1.5.0.7 nightly á örgjörva. Run í viðmótinu notar aðra eldri vinnsluvél sem er ekki keyrð hér. Einkagögn á NAS: screenA/20200202_6W-LaC024A, sequencing/images/input/c1, staðir 0, 1, 10 og 11. Heimilaðan aðgang þarf; þetta er ekki opinbert prófunarniðurhal og veitir ekki endurdreifingarleyfi. Hver uint16-TIFF skrá hefur fimm plön með 1480 × 1480 mynddílum; DAPI er á plani núll. Upprunalegu skipulagi 333 staða er haldið. Ekki yfirfæra skipulag, skörun eða viðmið á aðra myndatöku án mælinga. Veldu nýja úttaksmöppu utan frumgagnanna. Heill brunnur, frumuskipting, samstilling milli lota, afkóðun og líffræðileg greining eru ekki sýnd.

scenes.narration: Ljósmyndamiðuð hópskimun byrjar á myndum af aðliggjandi sjónsviðum úr endurteknum myndatökulotum. Opnaðu Mask í spaCR til að finna innfelldu OPS-síðuna. Þessi kennslustund sýnir staðsetningu hennar og lítið, sannreynt dæmi um samstillingu mynda.
Notaðu OPS-rofann í aðgerðalínu Mask. Hann opnar sérstaka síðu innan aðaleiningarinnar. OPS er ekki annar hnappur á Home og ekki Map Barcodes-vinnuferlið fyrir skrár með raðgreiningarlestrum.

Núverandi OPS-síða hefur stillingar fyrir inntak, samsetningu mynda, myndmósaík, samstillingu og gæðaeftirlit. Run-hnappurinn notar aðra eldri vinnsluvél. Við ræsum hana ekki og fullyrðum ekki að allt skimunarferlið hafi verið sannreynt. Næstu skref nota rúmfræðiskilin beint.

Þetta örgjörvadæmi samstillir og sameinar fjórar raunverulegar myndflísar úr fyrirliggjandi myndatöku. Það afmarkar ekki frumur, afkóðar ekki strikamerki og vinnur ekki heila plötu. Frumgögnin fylgja ekki sem prófunarniðurhal; nákvæm endurtekning krefst heimilaðs aðgangs að skránum.

Veldu staði núll, einn, tíu og ellefu úr fyrstu myndatökulotunni. Hver frumskrá hefur fimm plön; plan núll inniheldur kjarnalitun. Haltu upprunalegu skipulagi þrjú hundruð þrjátíu og þriggja staða og númerum þeirra. Fjórar valdar flísar skilgreina ekki nýjan brunn með aðeins fjórum flísum.

Hjálparforritið kallar á stitch_well, athugar allar fjórar skaranir milli nágranna og kallar síðan á compose_window. Allar fjórar flísarnar eru staðsettar. Samsetti hlutinn er tvö þúsund sjö hundruð fimmtíu og sex mynddílar á kant. Í þessari myndatöku lokast rúmfræðilykkjan með skekkju innan fjórðungs mynddíls; það er ekki almenn nákvæmnisábyrgð.

Ekki treysta aðeins á staðsetningu. Berðu saman raunverulega skarandi mynddíla óháð samstillingareinkunninni. Hér er fylgnin eftir samstillingu mun sterkari en þegar öðrum hvorum ásnum er vísvitandi hliðrað um sautján mynddíla. Slík röng hliðrun sem viðmið hjálpar að finna trúverðuga en ranga staðsetningu.

Skoðaðu myndina og þekjukortið sem voru raunverulega vistuð. Vinstri ramminn sýnir samsettu kjarnamyndina; sá hægri telur flísarnar sem leggja til gögn. Núll þekja merkir að mynddíla vantar úr upptökunni, ekki líffræðilegan bakgrunn. Hér eru sameinaðir rúmfræðilegir nágrannar á einu plani, aldrei ólíkar raðgreiningarlotur.

Geymdu fylkið, þekjuna, staðsetningar, gátsummur frumskráa og keyrsluskýrsluna saman. Forritið opnar niðurstöður aftur og staðfestir að allar fjórar frumskrárnar séu óbreyttar. Þetta er endurtakanlegt rúmfræðilegt athugunarskref. Full kennsla í ljósmyndamiðaðri skimun krefst enn sérstakrar sannprófunar á síðari stigum.

lessons.title: Skimanir með spaCR
lessons.description: Fylgdu myndbyggðri skimun á sameinuðu safni frá Home, í gegnum myndmælingar, svipgerðarflokkun og talningu strikamerkja, að aðhvarfsgreiningu.
objectives: Velja upphafseiningu út frá þeim gögnum sem þegar eru tiltæk.
Átta sig á hvaða gögn hver eining les og skrifar.
Nota tengdar kennslustundir eininganna og API-lýsingar fyrir næsta skref.
lessons.prerequisite: Settu upp spaCR og opnaðu Home. Þessi kennslustund útskýrir leiðsögn og afhendingu gagna milli eininga; tengdar kennslustundir eininganna sýna útfærð dæmi með gögnum. Inntök og úttök fela í sér skilyrta valkosti sem eru útskýrðir fyrir hverja einingu.

scenes.narration: Byrjaðu á Home með það efni sem þú hefur þegar. Myndbyggð skimun á sameinuðu safni hefur tvær gagnagreinar: myndir lýsa svipgerðinni en raðgreining auðkennir þær truflanir sem eru til staðar í hverjum brunni. Mask, Measure, Annotate og Classify mynda myndgreinina. Map Barcodes myndar raðgreiningargreinina. Regression sameinar samhæf skor og talningar leiðsöguraða. Þetta eru tengdar gagnaafurðir, ekki sex hnappar sem alltaf þarf að keyra í fastri röð.

Opnaðu Mask frá Home. Veldu rásir og líkön, skoðaðu forskoðun og keyrðu síðan Mask. Measure notar sameinuðu fylkin; talningagagnagrunnurinn er enn ekki tafla með mælieiginleikum. Inntaksgögn: smásjármyndir; vistuð staða aðgreiningarlíkans. Úttaksgögn: myndir og merkjagrímur; merkjagrímur; fjöldi hluta. Frá Mask til Measure: notaðu sama verkefni og rétta rásarvísa fyrir myndir og grímur.

Opnaðu Measure frá Home. Measure les myndir og merkjaplön saman. Virkjaðu vistun útskurða ef þú þarft PNG-skrár; haltu gagnagrunninum og upprunaverkefninu saman fyrir útskurði sem eru lesnir eftir þörfum. Inntaksgögn: myndir og merkjagrímur; merkjagrímur. Úttaksgögn: mældir hlutir; útskurðir af hlutum. Frá Mask til Measure: notaðu sama verkefni og rétta rásarvísa fyrir myndir og grímur. Frá Measure til Annotate: vistaðu eða lestu útskurði eftir þörfum með stöðugum auðkennum hluta. Frá Measure til Classify: veldu myndafjölskylduna eða töflugagnafjölskylduna eftir inntakinu.

Opnaðu Annotate frá Home. Merktu dæmigerða hluti í png_list fyrir stýrt nám. Notaðu aðskildar merkingar fyrir ólíkar spurningar og haltu þjálfunar- og matshópum óháðum. Inntaksgögn: mældir hlutir; útskurðir af hlutum; endurnýtanleg valsvæði. Úttaksgögn: þjálfunarmerkingar. Frá Measure til Annotate: vistaðu eða lestu útskurði eftir þörfum með stöðugum auðkennum hluta. Frá Annotate til Classify: haltu merktum þjálfunar- og matshópum aðskildum.

Opnaðu Classify frá Home. Veldu Computer Vision fyrir útskurði eða myndir af hlutum sem eru lesnar eftir þörfum, eða Tabular Machine Learning fyrir dálka með mældum eiginleikum. Fjölskyldurnar tvær nota ólík inntök. Inntaksgögn: mældir hlutir; útskurðir af hlutum; þjálfunarmerkingar. Úttaksgögn: flokkunarskor hluta; þjálfað myndflokkunarlíkan; aðlagað flokkunarlíkan fyrir eiginleika; matsgagnapakki fyrir flokkunarlíkan. Frá Measure til Classify: veldu myndafjölskylduna eða töflugagnafjölskylduna eftir inntakinu. Frá Annotate til Classify: haltu merktum þjálfunar- og matshópum aðskildum. Frá Classify til Regression: veldu viðeigandi CV- eða ML-skordálk og varðveittu auðkenni platna og brunna.

Opnaðu Map Barcodes frá Home. Leggðu fram viðmiðunarraðirnar sem kóða tilraunina þína. Skoðaðu talningar úthlutaðra raða og gæðaeftirlit strikamerkja áður en þú parar talningar leiðsöguraða í hverjum brunni við svipgerðarskor. Inntaksgögn: raðgreiningarlestrar. Úttaksgögn: talningar leiðsöguraða í hverjum brunni. Frá Map Barcodes til Regression: paraðu talningar leiðsöguraða við svipgerðarskor með samræmdum lyklum fyrir plötur og brunna.

Opnaðu Regression frá Home. Láttu auðkenni platna og brunna samsvara milli svipgerðargagna og talninga leiðsöguraða, veldu svarbreytu og viðmið og skoðaðu greiningarprófanir áður en þú túlkar jákvæðar niðurstöður. Beint mæld svör eru einnig studd. Inntaksgögn: flokkunarskor hluta; talningar leiðsöguraða í hverjum brunni; úthlutanir ljósrænna strikamerkja; mældir hlutir. Úttaksgögn: niðurstöður aðhvarfsgreiningar og jákvæðar niðurstöður. Frá Classify til Regression: veldu viðeigandi CV- eða ML-skordálk og varðveittu auðkenni platna og brunna. Frá Map Barcodes til Regression: paraðu talningar leiðsöguraða við svipgerðarskor með samræmdum lyklum fyrir plötur og brunna. Frá OPS til Regression: tengdu eða safnaðu sérstaklega saman afkóðuðum hlutum í svipgerðar- og leiðsöguinntök fyrir Regression; þetta er ekki bein afhending CSV-skrár.

Athugaðu fyrir Regression að myndskor, raðgreiningartalningar og tilraunaskipan noti samsvarandi auðkenni platna og brunna. Varðveittu auðkenni hluta, merkingardálk, stillingar flokkunarlíkans og viðmiðunarraðir strikamerkja með keyrslunni. Notaðu tengdar kennslustundir eininganna til að sjá útfært dæmi um hvert skref; veldu leiðsögnina fyrir skimun á sameinuðu safni ef þú vilt að Home leiði þig um viðmótið.

lessons.title: Module inputs and outputs
lessons.description: Find every current module's input data, saved outputs, upstream producers and downstream consumers, including tools nested inside a Home module.
objectives: Choose a starting module from the data you already have.
Identify what each module reads and writes.
Follow the linked module lessons and API contracts for the next step.
lessons.prerequisite: Install spaCR and open Home. This lesson explains navigation and data handoffs; the linked module lessons provide the worked data examples. Inputs and outputs include conditional alternatives, as explained for each module.

scenes.narration: Choose a module by the data you have and the result you need. Home shows the main modules; related tools can open inside a parent. This chapter-by-chapter reference covers every current route. Inputs and outputs can be conditional: an image classifier and a feature classifier need different data, and a viewer does not automatically save everything it displays. The notes for each module explain those differences. Keep the original files and use the recorded object, plate and well identities when passing results between modules.

Open Mask from Home. Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table. Input data: Microscope images; Segmentation checkpoint. Microscope images: Source image folder; original files, supported vendor files or imported TIFFs. Segmentation checkpoint: Saved Cellpose-compatible checkpoint or a compatible installed backend selected with its own configuration. Output data: Images and label masks; Label masks; Object counts. Images and label masks: merged/*.npy in the project; channels and integer label planes share each field array. Label masks: masks/ when retained, or explicitly saved image/mask pairs. Intermediate masks may be removed by cleanup. Object counts: measurements/measurements.db; Mask counts alone are not per-object feature measurements. Mask to Measure: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices. Cellpose Workbench to Mask: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask. Import Images to Mask: Use imported image planes and identities; image-only imports still need segmentation. Format Converter to Mask: Use the converted layout and preserve source identity mappings. Mask to Timelapse: Enable the nested time-series route before generating linked labels. Import to Mask: For image-only imports, use Import Images or Format Converter and point Mask at the formatted image project. External measurements alone are not segmentation input.

Open Measure from Home. Measure reads images and label planes together. Enable crop saving if you need PNG files; keep the database and source project together for streamed crops. Input data: Images and label masks; Label masks. Output data: Measured objects; Object crops. Measured objects: measurements/measurements.db; object tables depend on the enabled cell, nucleus, pathogen and organelle masks. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: cell, nucleus, pathogen, cytoplasm. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: plateID, rowID, columnID, fieldID. Object crops: data/**/*_png when save_png is enabled; png_list indexes saved crops. Supported workflows can instead stream crops from merged arrays and masks. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: png_list. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: png_path, prcfo. Mask to Measure: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices. Measure to Annotate: Save or stream crops with stable object identities. Measure to Classify: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input. Make Masks to Measure: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays. External Masks to Measure: Re-measure only when needed; External Masks can already perform measurement. Measure to Image UMAP: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops. Measure to Embeddings: Retain encoder and channel-policy provenance. Measure to Gate Editor: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units. Measure to Graph Builder: Choose explicit variables, groups and filters. Measure to QC: Review available checks and missing evidence. Measure to Recruitment: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities. Measure to Invasion Assay: Require two-colour stain measurements and appropriate baseline controls. Measure to Replication Assay: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities. Timelapse to Measure: Use the time-series project with stable frame/object identities. Measure to Motility Assay: Combine measured objects with matching tracks. Measure to Feature Explorer: Define the class comparison and inspect filtering. Measure to Database Browser: Inspect actual tables before exporting. Measure to AnnData Export: Export compatible feature and metadata columns. Measure to Dose–Response: Join the measured response to explicit doses and controls. Measure to Endodyogeny size proxy: Supply the measured project roots and required object/png_list tables. Verify host-cell aggregation and area units before interpreting size bins; the Mask counts database alone is insufficient. Import to Measure: Import matching images and external integer masks to build merged project arrays, then open Measure on that project. Skip this step when compatible measurements have already been imported or computed. Do not append duplicate measurements to an existing imported table. Measure to Host–Pathogen Analysis: Keep uninfected cells in Measure. Supply whole-vacuole masks, host reference intensities and optional explicit parasite-to-vacuole links; host identity alone does not define a vacuole.

Open Annotate from Home. Label representative objects in png_list before supervised training. Use separate annotations for different questions and keep training and evaluation groups independent. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Reusable gates. Reusable gates: Saved threshold/polygon gate definitions or a selected object set; apply a gate to the same feature definitions. Output data: Training annotations. Training annotations: A chosen annotation column in measurements/measurements.db, table png_list; labels belong to object identities. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: png_list. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: prcfo. Measure to Annotate: Save or stream crops with stable object identities. Annotate to Classify: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate. External Masks to Annotate: Keep the newly measured project and crop index together. Import to Annotate: Imported tables require explicit column and object-identity mappings. Gate Editor to Annotate: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels. Annotate to Annotator Agreement: Choose independent annotation columns for the same objects.

Open Classify from Home. Choose Computer Vision for crops or streamed object images, or Tabular Machine Learning for measured feature columns. The two families consume different inputs. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Training annotations. Output data: Object classification scores; Trained image classifier; Fitted feature classifier; Classifier evaluation bundle. Object classification scores: Saved score CSVs and, when merged, measurements/measurements.db, table png_list. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: png_list. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: pred, cv_predictions, ml_pred, predictions. Trained image classifier: Saved classifier checkpoint, model settings and matching channel/preprocessing configuration. Fitted feature classifier: The fitted tabular classifier and its recorded feature list, training settings and validation results. Classifier evaluation bundle: Held-out predictions, labels, split metadata and calibration/leakage metrics for a saved classifier run. Measure to Classify: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input. Annotate to Classify: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate. Classify to Regression: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity. Classify to Classifier Evaluation: Use the matching held-out predictions and split metadata. Classify to Activation: Also provide the matching crops and channel preprocessing. Classify to Explain CV Model: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects. Gate Editor to Classify: Write reviewed gate selections to an annotation column, then select that same column and object population in Classify. Keep validation objects separate from training labels. Image UMAP to Classify: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.

Open Map Barcodes from Home. Supply the references that encode your experiment. Inspect mapped counts and barcode QC before pairing well-level guide counts with phenotype scores. Input data: Sequencing reads. Sequencing reads: Single-end or paired FASTQ files, with the matching barcode reference tables. Output data: Guide counts per well. Guide counts per well: Map Barcodes run folder: unique_combinations.csv and annotated_reads.h5. Well identity requires the corresponding barcode references. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: count. Map Barcodes to Regression: Pair guide counts with phenotype scores using consistent plate/well keys. Map Barcodes to Barcode QC: Check mapping and coverage before guide filtering.

Open Regression from Home. Match plate and well identifiers across phenotype and guide-count inputs, select the response and controls, and inspect diagnostics before interpreting hits. Direct measured responses are also supported. Input data: Object classification scores; Guide counts per well; Optical barcode assignments; Measured objects. Optical barcode assignments: OPS destination measurements.db: per-well geometry, phenotype alignment, nuclei and barcode tables; optional per-cycle reads. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: ops_geometry, ops_phenotype, ops_objects, ops_barcodes, ops_reads. Output data: Regression results and hits. Regression results and hits: Selected run results folder: coefficient/result CSVs, hit tables, settings and diagnostic figures. Classify to Regression: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity. Map Barcodes to Regression: Pair guide counts with phenotype scores using consistent plate/well keys. OPS to Regression: Join/aggregate decoded objects to phenotype and guide inputs explicitly before Regression; this is not a direct CSV handoff. Regression to Run Compare: Compare compatible saved result sets and their settings. Regression to Hit List: Inspect ranked hits and guide agreement. Regression to Volcano Explorer: Inspect saved effects and adjusted significance. Regression to Diagnostics: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run. Regression to Methods & Results: Review exported prose and every traced result. Regression to Investigate Hit: Join compatible phenotype and object data for the chosen hit.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Feature Explorer. Rank measured features for a chosen class comparison; review filtering and class definitions before interpreting the ranking. Input data: Measured objects; Training annotations. Output data: Figures and table exports. Figures and table exports: The output location chosen by the tool; exports describe the selected data and filters. Measure to Feature Explorer: Define the class comparison and inspect filtering.

Open Import from Home, then choose Format Converter. Convert supported microscope formats to a configured TIFF layout while preserving source mappings. Conversion does not generate object measurements. Input data: Microscope images. Output data: Microscope images. Format Converter to Mask: Use the converted layout and preserve source identity mappings.

Open Import from Home. Import external measurements with explicit object/column mappings, or choose Import Images, Format Converter or External Masks. Imported measurements are not a fresh Measure run. With matching source images and external integer masks, Import builds the merged project arrays used by Measure. Choose the route matching your files and inspect object identities before measuring; imported feature tables can be used directly when they already contain the required measurements. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks; External measurements. External measurements: Third-party measurement CSV/database tables and their image, mask and object-identity mappings. Output data: Measured objects; Object crops; Images and label masks; Label masks. Import to Annotate: Imported tables require explicit column and object-identity mappings. Import to Measure: Import matching images and external integer masks to build merged project arrays, then open Measure on that project. Skip this step when compatible measurements have already been imported or computed. Do not append duplicate measurements to an existing imported table. Import to Mask: For image-only imports, use Import Images or Format Converter and point Mask at the formatted image project. External measurements alone are not segmentation input.

Open Import from Home, then choose External Masks. Assign corresponding images and existing integer label masks, then create and measure a spaCR project without rerunning segmentation. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Images and label masks; Measured objects; Object crops. External Masks to Measure: Re-measure only when needed; External Masks can already perform measurement. External Masks to Annotate: Keep the newly measured project and crop index together. Direct Cellpose mask generation to External Masks: Provide the saved label TIFFs and their original images to External Masks, assign object roles and create the merged project before Measure.

Find Plate Queue in the application's Help or tools menus. Run the chosen pipeline across plates. Outputs are those of each queued module; retain each plate and its settings separately. Input data: Run queue. Run queue: Saved module/plate/settings job definitions and dependency order. Output data: Run history and artifacts. Run history and artifacts: Project run records, settings, output paths, artifact provenance, status and logs.

Find Batch Runner in the application's Help or tools menus. Validate and execute module jobs in dependency order. Each job writes its own module outputs and log. Input data: Run queue. Output data: Run history and artifacts.

Find Distributed Jobs in the application's Help or tools menus. Submit a configured run to a remote execution target and inspect its status and logs. Retrieve the actual module artifacts before downstream analysis. Input data: Run queue. Output data: Run history and artifacts.

Find Database Browser in the application's Help or tools menus. Browse selected tables and export rows; table inspection does not rerun image analysis. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports. Measure to Database Browser: Inspect actual tables before exporting.

Find Run History in the application's Help or tools menus. Inspect saved run status, settings, outputs and logs; a completed run does not establish biological validity. Input data: Run history and artifacts. Output data: Run history and artifacts.

Find Report in the application's Help or tools menus. Package recorded results, settings and QC into a shareable report without silently rerunning the analysis. Input data: Run history and artifacts; Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Quality-control results: Stored project checks and QC reports; a missing check is not a passing result. Output data: Shareable reports. Shareable reports: Exported HTML/PDF or methods/results documents derived from recorded analysis outputs.

Find Data Manager in the application's Help or tools menus. Inspect project files and disk usage. Removing derived artifacts invalidates downstream uses of those files; original images must remain recoverable. Input data: Run history and artifacts. Output data: Run history and artifacts.

Find Pipeline Graph in the application's Help or tools menus. Read recorded artifact dependencies and stale/missing status. The graph describes provenance and does not regenerate missing artifacts. Input data: Run history and artifacts. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open QC from Home. Inspect stored segmentation, unit, leakage and plate-effect checks. Open its nested viewers for detailed inspection. Input data: Measured objects; Quality-control results. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Measure to QC: Review available checks and missing evidence.

Open Database Browser through Help search, then choose Lineage. Inspect recorded cell/nucleus/pathogen/organelle containment links; this is object containment, not time-series lineage inference. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Experiment Design from Home. Enter conditions, controls, replicates and plate constraints, then export the experimental layout before acquisition. Input data: Screen design and power estimates. Screen design and power estimates: Saved planning tables or figures based on explicitly chosen effect sizes, variability and sampling assumptions. Output data: Experimental layout. Experimental layout: Exported plate/condition/control/replicate map. Keep its plate and well identifiers consistent with the acquired data. Experiment Design to Power / Design: Use the experimental layout to define sampling assumptions, then revise the design. Experiment Design to Dose–Response: Acquire and measure the experiment first, preserving dose/condition identities.

Open QC from Home, then choose Layer Viewer. Inspect aligned image, label and point/ROI layers for the selected field. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Power / Design from Home. Estimate sampling needs from chosen effect sizes and variability; pilot measurements are optional evidence for assumptions. Input data: Screen design and power estimates; Measured objects; Experimental layout. Output data: Screen design and power estimates. Experiment Design to Power / Design: Use the experimental layout to define sampling assumptions, then revise the design.

Open Run Compare from Home. Compare compatible saved settings, counts and hit lists without treating changed input data as a controlled model comparison. Input data: Run history and artifacts; Regression results and hits. Output data: Run/model comparison. Run/model comparison: Comparison tables and figures from compatible saved runs or masks; agreement is not ground-truth accuracy. Regression to Run Compare: Compare compatible saved result sets and their settings.

Open Database Browser through Help search, then choose Tabulate. Choose grouping variables and measurement columns, then inspect pivot tables and groupwise sample sizes. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Dose–Response from Home. Supply dose and response columns, controls and units before curve fitting; this route does not require sequencing. Input data: Measured objects; Experimental layout. Output data: Assay results; Figures and table exports. Assay results: Assay-specific result tables and figures in the configured destination, preserving well and condition identities. Experiment Design to Dose–Response: Acquire and measure the experiment first, preserving dose/condition identities. Measure to Dose–Response: Join the measured response to explicit doses and controls.

Find Project Browser in the application's Help or tools menus. Locate projects and inspect their stage, last run, disk use and stale outputs. Input data: Run history and artifacts. Output data: Run history and artifacts.

Open QC from Home, then choose Outliers. Review robust object/well outlier scores and the selected exclusion rule before carrying filtered data into analysis. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports.

Open Embeddings from Home. Encode object images with a chosen model and channel policy. Retain object identities and encoder provenance when supplying the features to downstream exploration. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops. Output data: Image embeddings. Image embeddings: Object-indexed encoder features, with channel policy and encoder provenance. The encoding API returns features; persistence is caller-dependent. Measure to Embeddings: Retain encoder and channel-policy provenance. Embeddings to Image UMAP: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it.

Open QC from Home, then choose Control Charts. Compare designated controls across plates and inspect drift; the definition of a control comes from the experiment. Input data: Measured objects; Experimental layout. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Training Runs. Compare saved training histories, metrics and settings from compatible model runs. Input data: Run history and artifacts. Output data: Run/model comparison.

Open Align & Stitch from Home. Inspect tile geometry, overlap and channel mapping, then save the mosaic with coordinate records. OPS also needs the original cycle/site identities. Input data: Microscope images. Output data: Aligned mosaic and coordinates. Aligned mosaic and coordinates: Align & Stitch destination: composed image and the tile-coordinate/layout records needed to interpret it. Align & Stitch to OPS: Carry tile coordinates and original sequencing cycles into OPS; a flattened mosaic alone is insufficient.

Open Make Masks from Home. Curate image/mask pairs for segmentation training, or use FEATURES to assign images and masks and invoke measurement. Saving a mask does not train a classifier. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Curated training fields; Label masks. Curated training fields: Separate image and integer-mask files with matching field identities; preserve original images and labels. Make Masks to Cellpose Workbench: Use independently checked image/mask pairs. Make Masks to Measure: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays. Make Masks to Plaque Assay: Use plaque masks with matching source images; cell masks are not automatically plaque labels.

Open Graph Builder from Home, then choose Plate Viewer. Aggregate the selected measurement by well and inspect plate patterns and controls. Input data: Measured objects; Experimental layout. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Image UMAP from Home. Project measured features or supplied encoder features and inspect representative crops. A cluster is a candidate grouping, not a validated phenotype. Use the lasso and annotation controls to write reviewed selections to an annotation column in the matching measurement database. A geometric selection alone does not establish a biological phenotype. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Image embeddings. Output data: Projection and clusters; Training annotations. Projection and clusters: Image UMAP/PCA coordinate tables, selected clusters and figures for the loaded measurement data. Measure to Image UMAP: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops. Embeddings to Image UMAP: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it. Image UMAP to Gate Editor: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection. Image UMAP to Classify: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Prediction Profiler. Inspect how a fitted model responds as an input feature changes; predictions do not establish causal effects. Input data: Fitted feature classifier. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Graph Builder from Home. Choose variables, groups and plotting settings from the loaded table, then export the figure with its analysis context. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports. Measure to Graph Builder: Choose explicit variables, groups and filters.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Investigate Hit. Link a regression hit to candidate objects and quantitative well-level evidence. This does not independently validate the hit. Input data: Regression results and hits; Object classification scores; Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports. Regression to Investigate Hit: Join compatible phenotype and object data for the chosen hit.

Open Gate Editor from Home. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels. Input data: Measured objects; Projection and clusters. Output data: Reusable gates; Training annotations. Image UMAP to Gate Editor: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection. Gate Editor to Annotate: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels. Measure to Gate Editor: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units. Gate Editor to Classify: Write reviewed gate selections to an annotation column, then select that same column and object population in Classify. Keep validation objects separate from training labels.

Find Feature Dictionary in the application's Help or tools menus. Look up feature definitions and units before choosing measurement columns. Input data: Feature definitions. Feature definitions: The installed feature dictionary; definitions describe existing measurements and do not compute them. Output data: Feature definitions.

Open Graph Builder from Home, then choose Small Multiples. Compare groups in small-multiple plots with explicit shared or independent axes. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Figures and table exports.

Open Toxoplasma from Home, then choose Plaque Assay. Analyse plaque images or existing masks with the configured plaque model. This route need not pass through Measure; use the dedicated plaque example. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Assay results; Label masks. Make Masks to Plaque Assay: Use plaque masks with matching source images; cell masks are not automatically plaque labels.

Open Toxoplasma from Home, then choose Recruitment. Use compartment intensity measurements and matching host/pathogen identities to compute recruitment ratios. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Assay results. Measure to Recruitment: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities.

Open Toxoplasma from Home, then choose Host–Pathogen Analysis. Measure whole vacuoles and host reference compartments, keeping uninfected host cells for the infection denominator. Select marker channels and control-calibrated ratio thresholds. Optionally count individually segmented parasites from explicit vacuole links or a measured count column. Review vacuole, host and well tables, joint marker states, replication distributions and unmatched parasite links; unknown measurements remain unknown. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Assay results. Measure to Host–Pathogen Analysis: Keep uninfected cells in Measure. Supply whole-vacuole masks, host reference intensities and optional explicit parasite-to-vacuole links; host identity alone does not define a vacuole.

Open Toxoplasma from Home, then choose Invasion Assay. Use the required two-colour differential-staining measurements and stain-baseline controls to distinguish attachment from invasion. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Assay results. Measure to Invasion Assay: Require two-colour stain measurements and appropriate baseline controls.

Open Toxoplasma from Home, then choose Replication Assay. Count parasites using explicit vacuole identity and compare condition distributions; host identity alone does not define a vacuole. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Assay results. Measure to Replication Assay: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Cellpose Workbench. Open Cellpose Workbench inside Make Masks and train from verified image/mask pairs. Evaluate on separate fields before selecting the checkpoint in Mask. Input data: Curated training fields. Output data: Segmentation checkpoint. Make Masks to Cellpose Workbench: Use independently checked image/mask pairs. Cellpose Workbench to Mask: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask. Cellpose Workbench to Direct Cellpose mask generation: Pass the trained checkpoint as custom_model with the matching image channels and preprocessing.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Mask the whole folder. Apply the selected segmentation model to the open image folder through Make Masks; inspect saved labels before measuring them. Input data: Microscope images; Segmentation checkpoint. Output data: Label masks.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Model Compare. Compare model masks on identical fields. Without independent reference labels, agreement does not measure segmentation accuracy. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks; Segmentation checkpoint. Output data: Run/model comparison.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Model Zoo. Inspect model provenance and download/install compatible checkpoints or backends. A listed backend is not itself a checkpoint file. Input data: Segmentation checkpoint. Output data: Segmentation checkpoint.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Curate. Correct labels and track assignments while retaining a record of the edits. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks; Linked time-series objects. Linked time-series objects: Tracked labels and frame/object associations from the time-series project, with frame interval and units. Output data: Label masks; Linked time-series objects.

Open Make Masks from Home, then choose Napari Bridge. Send the matching image/labels to napari and import the revised labels back with field identity preserved. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Label masks.

Open Import from Home, then choose Import Images. Review field identities, image channels and optional external masks before writing a separate project. Image-only imports still need segmentation before measurement. Input data: Microscope images. Output data: Microscope images; Images and label masks; Label masks. Import Images to Mask: Use imported image planes and identities; image-only imports still need segmentation.

Open Map Barcodes from Home, then choose Barcode QC. Inspect mapping depth, coverage, collisions and positional effects before guide-count filtering. Input data: Guide counts per well. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Map Barcodes to Barcode QC: Check mapping and coverage before guide filtering.

Open Image UMAP from Home, then choose Image Scatter. Plot selected measurement columns with object-crop inspection. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops. Output data: Projection and clusters; Figures and table exports.

Open Image UMAP from Home, then choose PCA. Inspect principal components and feature loadings for the selected measured objects. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: Projection and clusters; Figures and table exports.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Volcano Explorer. Open a saved regression result and inspect effect sizes, adjusted significance and individual hit records. Input data: Regression results and hits. Output data: Figures and table exports. Regression to Volcano Explorer: Inspect saved effects and adjusted significance.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Hit List. Filter and rank saved hits with their effects, FDR and guide agreement. Input data: Regression results and hits. Output data: Figures and table exports. Regression to Hit List: Inspect ranked hits and guide agreement.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Methods & Results. Draft methods/results text from recorded settings and results; review every claim before publication. Input data: Run history and artifacts; Regression results and hits. Output data: Shareable reports. Regression to Methods & Results: Review exported prose and every traced result.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Diagnostics. Inspect the diagnostic panels saved by the chosen regression run; distinguish missing diagnostics from passed assumptions. Input data: Regression results and hits. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Regression to Diagnostics: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run.

Open Measure from Home, then choose Illumination. Estimate and apply flat-field correction at configured stages. Keep corrected display values distinct from raw measurements and record the applied policy. Input data: Microscope images. Output data: Microscope images.

Open Measure from Home, then choose AnnData Export. Export an AnnData .h5ad file with object metadata and measured features for downstream single-cell analysis. Input data: Measured objects. Output data: AnnData export. AnnData export: An exported .h5ad file containing measured features and object metadata. Measure to AnnData Export: Export compatible feature and metadata columns.

Open Measure from Home, then choose Motility Assay. Inspect track speed and infection-related measurements with an explicit frame interval and pixel calibration. Input data: Linked time-series objects; Measured objects. Output data: Assay results; Figures and table exports. Timelapse to Motility Assay: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration. Measure to Motility Assay: Combine measured objects with matching tracks.

Open Mask from Home, then choose Timelapse. Open Timelapse within Mask to segment and link objects across ordered frames; inspect links before downstream motility analysis. Input data: Microscope images. Output data: Images and label masks; Label masks; Linked time-series objects. Mask to Timelapse: Enable the nested time-series route before generating linked labels. Timelapse to Measure: Use the time-series project with stable frame/object identities. Timelapse to Motility Assay: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration.

Open Mask from Home, then choose OPS. Use sequencing-cycle images and phenotype alignment to decode barcodes per nucleus. Aggregate/join the decoded identities to compatible phenotype inputs before Regression; the OPS database is not a drop-in FASTQ count CSV. Input data: Microscope images; Aligned mosaic and coordinates. Output data: Optical barcode assignments. Align & Stitch to OPS: Carry tile coordinates and original sequencing cycles into OPS; a flattened mosaic alone is insufficient. OPS to Regression: Join/aggregate decoded objects to phenotype and guide inputs explicitly before Regression; this is not a direct CSV handoff.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Classifier Evaluation. Inspect held-out predictions, calibration and split/leakage evidence for the matching classifier. Input data: Classifier evaluation bundle. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Classify to Classifier Evaluation: Use the matching held-out predictions and split metadata.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Explain CV Model. Fit a measured-feature surrogate to existing computer-vision scores, preserving identity joins. A surrogate explanation is not causality. Input data: Measured objects; Object classification scores. Output data: Fitted feature classifier; Figures and table exports. Classify to Explain CV Model: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Activation. Apply the matching image classifier and preprocessing to inspect saliency/model-response maps. Input data: Trained image classifier; Object crops. Output data: Image attribution maps. Image attribution maps: Saved model-response/saliency images for the matching classifier and input preprocessing. Classify to Activation: Also provide the matching crops and channel preprocessing.

Open Annotate from Home, then choose Annotator Agreement. Compare independent annotation columns and inspect discordant objects; agreement is separate from classification accuracy. Input data: Training annotations; Object crops. Output data: Quality-control results; Figures and table exports. Annotate to Annotator Agreement: Choose independent annotation columns for the same objects.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Computer Vision. Train an image classifier from labelled object crops, archives or supported streamed crops. Match channels and preprocessing when applying its checkpoint. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Training annotations. Output data: Object classification scores; Trained image classifier; Classifier evaluation bundle.

Open Classify from Home, then choose Tabular Machine Learning. Train a feature-based classifier from measured objects and labels. Inspect missing-feature exclusions and grouped held-out performance before using scores. Input data: Measured objects; Training annotations. Output data: Object classification scores; Fitted feature classifier; Classifier evaluation bundle.

Open Regression from Home, then choose Parameter Sweep. Run explicitly selected regression settings and compare their diagnostics. Keep the input data and evaluation question fixed. Input data: Object classification scores; Guide counts per well. Output data: Run/model comparison; Regression results and hits.

Open Toxoplasma from Home. Open the organism guide from Home, inspect the compartment diagram, then select Plaque Assay, Recruitment, Invasion Assay or Replication Assay. The four Coming soon tiles describe proposals and cannot run. The guide itself does not analyse a project or produce a measurement table. Input data: Bundled organism reference. Bundled organism reference: Installed organism descriptions and SwissBioPics cell diagrams; no project input is required. Output data: Organism guide and assay selection. Organism guide and assay selection: GUI-only compartment highlights and navigation to available assays; no measurements or files are produced.

Open Plasmodium spp. from Home. Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned malaria imaging workflows and inspect the shared apicomplexan diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result. Input data: Bundled organism reference. Output data: Organism guide and assay selection.

Open Candida spp. from Home. Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned fungal imaging workflows and inspect the generic budding-yeast diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result. Input data: Bundled organism reference. Output data: Organism guide and assay selection.

Use Endodyogeny size proxy from Python through spacr.submodules.analyze_endodyogeny. This API-only workflow has no Home tile or menu entry. Read measured compartment areas, annotate conditions and bin area ** 1.5 into log2 size doublings. Defaults aggregate pathogen area per host cell, not per vacuole: multiple vacuoles in one cell are combined. This is an area-derived size proxy, not measured volume or a parasite count. Use Replication Assay with explicit vacuole identity for parasites-per-vacuole counts. Configure compartment, area filters, calibration, conditions and grouping before calling the API; saving is optional. Input data: Host-cell-aggregated compartment areas. Host-cell-aggregated compartment areas: Each src project root/measurements/measurements.db; tables defaults to cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm, with png_list added for merging. The compartment setting selects the area column; default pathogen_area is summed per host cell. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: cell, nucleus, pathogen, cytoplasm, png_list. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: cell_id, pathogen_area. Output data: Area-derived size-proxy results. Area-derived size-proxy results: Returned data and chi_squared DataFrames; save=True also writes data.csv, chi_squared_results.csv, chi_squared_pairwise_results.csv and a figure under the first project root/results/analyze_endodyogeny/. Relevant columns depend on the selected route: pathogen_area, pathogen_volume, pathogen_volume_bin, bin_index. Measure to Endodyogeny size proxy: Supply the measured project roots and required object/png_list tables. Verify host-cell aggregation and area units before interpreting size bins; the Mask counts database alone is insufficient.

Use Direct Cellpose mask generation from Python through spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune. This API-only workflow has no Home tile or menu entry. Run a stock or custom Cellpose model on TIFF fields through the Python API. Despite its historical identify_masks_finetune name, this function performs inference, not training. Review normalization, channels, resizing and model parameters; masks are written only when save is enabled. Import compatible image/mask pairs through External Masks before Measure, or curate the pairs before training. This call does not build a Measure-ready merged project. Input data: TIFF fields for direct Cellpose inference; Segmentation checkpoint. TIFF fields for direct Cellpose inference: Top-level, lowercase .tif files in src; existing same-name files in src/masks are skipped. Supply the configured channels and a compatible stock model_name or custom_model checkpoint. Output data: Direct Cellpose TIFF masks. Direct Cellpose TIFF masks: When save=True, src/masks/<image-name>.tif contains integer labels. The call returns None and does not produce merged arrays or measurements.db. Cellpose Workbench to Direct Cellpose mask generation: Pass the trained checkpoint as custom_model with the matching image channels and preprocessing. Direct Cellpose mask generation to External Masks: Provide the saved label TIFFs and their original images to External Masks, assign object roles and create the merged project before Measure.

Use Pooled-screen simulation sweep from Python through spacr.sim.run_multiple_simulations. This API-only workflow has no Home tile or menu entry. Use the Python sweep API to explore stated screen-design assumptions. It expands combinations, runs simulations in a process pool and writes synthetic summary statistics; it returns None. Set a small explicit max_workers value and a bounded parameter grid before running. The output does not replace measurements or barcode counts for experimental Regression. Use the findings as planning evidence, with their assumptions recorded. Review the synthetic summaries when choosing planning assumptions; transfer those assumptions manually into Power / Design or Experiment Design. Neither tool imports this simulation database, and neither exports the simulation settings grid. Input data: Pooled-screen simulation assumptions. Pooled-screen simulation assumptions: Python settings dictionary: iterable sweep values for screen size, occupancy, classifier accuracy and sequencing assumptions, plus replicates, src, name, variable, plot and max_workers. generate_parameters expands their Cartesian product; begin with a small sweep and an explicit worker bound. Output data: Synthetic screen simulation summaries. Synthetic screen simulation summaries: src/<YYMMDD>/<name>/simulations.db; the sweep appends summary rows to simulations and optionally writes plots. These are synthetic performance estimates, not measured experimental hits. Relevant tables depend on the selected route: simulations.

Return to the chapter matching your next data product rather than repeating work you already completed. A count table is not a measured feature table, a projection is not a trained classifier, and a comparison is not a new experiment. The linked API pages carry the same file, table and column contracts, and the specialist lessons demonstrate the individual controls.

lessons.title: Image analysis modules and how they relate
lessons.description: Choose an image-analysis route through segmentation, measurement, annotation, classification, projections, gates, image registration, quality control and assays.
objectives: Choose a starting module from the data you already have.
Identify what each module reads and writes.
Follow the linked module lessons and API contracts for the next step.
lessons.prerequisite: Install spaCR and open Home. This lesson explains navigation and data handoffs; the linked module lessons provide the worked data examples. Inputs and outputs include conditional alternatives, as explained for each module.

scenes.narration: Begin on Home by deciding whether you have raw images, existing masks or measured objects. Mask creates segmentation outputs; Make Masks curates individual fields; Measure turns compatible images and labels into object measurements and optional crops. From there, the scientific question determines whether to classify, explore a projection, define a gate or run an assay. Align tiled images before the analysis that needs a common coordinate system. The routes here are alternatives and branches, not a requirement to run every module.

Open Mask from Home. Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table. Input data: Microscope images; Segmentation checkpoint. Output data: Images and label masks; Label masks; Object counts. Mask to Measure: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices.

Open Make Masks from Home. Curate image/mask pairs for segmentation training, or use FEATURES to assign images and masks and invoke measurement. Saving a mask does not train a classifier. Input data: Microscope images; Label masks. Output data: Curated training fields; Label masks. Make Masks to Measure: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays. Make Masks to Plaque Assay: Use plaque masks with matching source images; cell masks are not automatically plaque labels.

Open Measure from Home. Measure reads images and label planes together. Enable crop saving if you need PNG files; keep the database and source project together for streamed crops. Input data: Images and label masks; Label masks. Output data: Measured objects; Object crops. Mask to Measure: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices. Measure to Annotate: Save or stream crops with stable object identities. Measure to Classify: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input. Make Masks to Measure: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays. Measure to Image UMAP: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops. Measure to Embeddings: Retain encoder and channel-policy provenance. Measure to Gate Editor: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units. Measure to QC: Review available checks and missing evidence. Measure to Recruitment: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities. Measure to Invasion Assay: Require two-colour stain measurements and appropriate baseline controls. Measure to Replication Assay: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities. Measure to Endodyogeny size proxy: Supply the measured project roots and required object/png_list tables. Verify host-cell aggregation and area units before interpreting size bins; the Mask counts database alone is insufficient. Measure to Host–Pathogen Analysis: Keep uninfected cells in Measure. Supply whole-vacuole masks, host reference intensities and optional explicit parasite-to-vacuole links; host identity alone does not define a vacuole.

Open Annotate from Home. Label representative objects in png_list before supervised training. Use separate annotations for different questions and keep training and evaluation groups independent. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Reusable gates. Output data: Training annotations. Measure to Annotate: Save or stream crops with stable object identities. Annotate to Classify: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate. Gate Editor to Annotate: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels.

Open Classify from Home. Choose Computer Vision for crops or streamed object images, or Tabular Machine Learning for measured feature columns. The two families consume different inputs. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Training annotations. Output data: Object classification scores; Trained image classifier; Fitted feature classifier; Classifier evaluation bundle. Measure to Classify: Choose the image or tabular family to match your input. Annotate to Classify: Keep labelled training and evaluation groups separate. Classify to Regression: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity. Gate Editor to Classify: Write reviewed gate selections to an annotation column, then select that same column and object population in Classify. Keep validation objects separate from training labels. Image UMAP to Classify: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.

Open Image UMAP from Home. Project measured features or supplied encoder features and inspect representative crops. A cluster is a candidate grouping, not a validated phenotype. Use the lasso and annotation controls to write reviewed selections to an annotation column in the matching measurement database. A geometric selection alone does not establish a biological phenotype. Input data: Measured objects; Object crops; Image embeddings. Output data: Projection and clusters; Training annotations. Measure to Image UMAP: Choose feature columns and inspect representative crops. Embeddings to Image UMAP: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it. Image UMAP to Gate Editor: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection. Image UMAP to Classify: Write reviewed lasso selections to an annotation column in the matching object database, then select that column in Classify. Inspect crops and validate labels; embedding clusters are not ground truth.

Open Gate Editor from Home. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels. Input data: Measured objects; Projection and clusters. Output data: Reusable gates; Training annotations. Image UMAP to Gate Editor: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection. Gate Editor to Annotate: Apply compatible gates, then review candidate labels. Measure to Gate Editor: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units.
